summaries.text: This resolution expresses support for the designation of May 2026 as Motorcycle Safety Awareness Month. It also recognizes the contribution of motorcycles to transportation.

title: A resolution expressing support for the designation of May 2026 as "Motorcycle Safety Awareness Month".
